too_large.title: Too large
too_large.body: The email was over the size limit.
too_large.action: Ask your notetaker for a shorter summary email, without attachments.

malformed.title: Broken email
malformed.body: Its headers were broken or repeated, so it could not be checked.
malformed.action: Send the summary again. If this keeps happening, the email may not be a real summary.

could_not_verify_after_forwarding.title: Signature lost on the way
could_not_verify_after_forwarding.body: Your mail service changed the email when it passed it on, so the notetaker's signature no longer matched.
could_not_verify_after_forwarding.action: Use a Redirect rule instead of Forward (in Outlook: Redirect to). See the setup steps.

changed_after_sending.title: Changed after sending
changed_after_sending.body: The notetaker's signature is there but no longer matches: the text was changed after it was sent.
changed_after_sending.action: If you did not expect this email, there is nothing to do. If it was your summary, check your forwarding rule and send it again.

sender_not_verified.title: Sender not verified
sender_not_verified.body: It claims to come from your notetaker or from one of your mailboxes, but no valid signature backs that up.
sender_not_verified.action: If it was yours, your mail service may not sign the mail it sends. Set up a Redirect rule so the notetaker's own email arrives instead.

not_from_your_notetaker.title: Not from your notetaker
not_from_your_notetaker.body: It does not come from a notetaker we accept, or someone else forwarded it.
not_from_your_notetaker.action: If you keep getting these, get a new address.

unreadable.title: No readable text
unreadable.body: The email was genuine, but no readable text was left in it.
unreadable.action: Forward it again with the summary in the body of the email, not as an attachment.

common.refusedNotStored: Refused emails are not stored by Meeting Guard AI. Only the reason, the day, a count and a verified sender domain are kept, for 30 days.

delete.title: Delete this summary?
delete.body: It leaves our live database at once and our backups within 21 days. The copy at our email provider expires after {{providerDays}} days. The original email stays in your own mailbox.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.encrypted: Encrypted in transit and at rest by Google Cloud. In addition, Meeting Guard AI encrypts each summary's text, subject and the email addresses in it with its own key, kept in Google Secret Manager. Your private address, the mailboxes you list, and details such as the date, the sender's domain and the meeting it is filed under do not get this extra layer. This is not end-to-end encryption: people with administrative access to our systems could technically decrypt it. Our email provider, Postmark, receives each email first and keeps it for {{providerDays}} days.
privacy.yoursOnly: Only you can see your summaries in the app; other Meeting Guard AI users cannot reach them.
privacy.deletable: You can delete any summary, or all of them, at any time. They leave our live database at once and our backups within 21 days. The copy at our email provider expires after {{providerDays}} days. The original email stays in your own mailbox.
privacy.refused: A summary that your notetaker did not sign, that was changed after it was sent, or that was not sent to one of your own mailboxes is refused, and its content is not kept by Meeting Guard AI. A real summary sent straight to your private address waits in your inbox for your OK.

setup.title: Set up forwarding
setup.browserHint: Do this in a web browser. The phone apps cannot set up forwarding.

steps.step1: Open Gmail settings, Forwarding and POP/IMAP, and press Add a forwarding address. Paste your private address, then press Next and Proceed.
steps.step2: Gmail sends a confirmation code to your private address. It shows up on this screen within a minute. Paste it on the same Gmail page and press Verify.
steps.step3: Leave forwarding of all your mail off.
steps.step4: Open Filters and Blocked Addresses and press Create a new filter. In From, enter your notetaker's sender address and press Create filter.
steps.step5: Choose Forward it to, pick your private address and press Create filter.

gmail.workspace: Google Workspace: if forwarding is greyed out, your administrator has to allow automatic forwarding first.

steps.step1: Open Outlook on the web, Settings, Mail, Rules, and press Add new rule.
steps.step2: Condition: From, your notetaker's sender address. Action: Redirect to, your private address. Save the rule.
steps.step3: Use Redirect, not Forward. Redirect keeps the notetaker as the sender, so its signature can be checked. Forward is not supported.

outlook.company: Company mailbox: Microsoft 365 blocks automatic forwarding to outside addresses by default. If nothing arrives, share the steps with your administrator.

steps.step1: In your mail service, create a rule for mail from your notetaker's sender address that sends it on to your private address.
steps.step2: Choose Redirect (or Bounce) if your mail service offers it. It keeps the notetaker's signature intact.
steps.step3: You can also forward one summary by hand from one of your mailboxes. It waits in your summary inbox for one tap.

admin.title: Steps for your administrator
admin.hint: Share these steps with whoever manages your company email.
admin.microsoft:
I use Meeting Guard AI to receive my meeting summaries. A mail rule on {{mailbox}} redirects only my notetaker's summary emails to {{address}}. Microsoft 365 blocks automatic forwarding to outside addresses by default. To allow it for this one mailbox:
1. In the Microsoft Defender portal (https://security.microsoft.com/antispam), create an outbound anti-spam policy that applies only to {{mailbox}}, with Automatic forwarding rules set to On - Forwarding is enabled.
2. In the Exchange admin center (https://admin.exchange.microsoft.com/#/remotedomains), check that the Default remote domain allows automatic forwarding.
No other mail is forwarded.
admin.google:
I use Meeting Guard AI to receive my meeting summaries. A Gmail filter on {{mailbox}} forwards only my notetaker's summary emails to {{address}}. Forwarding is greyed out in my Gmail settings. Please allow automatic forwarding for my account in the Google Admin console (https://admin.google.com), under Apps, Google Workspace, Gmail, End User Access.
No other mail is forwarded.

checks.title: What we check
checks.signature: The summary carries your notetaker's own digital signature, and nothing in it changed after it was sent.
checks.sender: It comes from a notetaker sender we accept.
checks.mailbox: It was sent to one of the mailboxes you listed above.
checks.fresh: It is recent: written in the last two weeks.
checks.match: It is filed by itself only when its title and its time both match one of your meetings. Otherwise it waits in your summary inbox.
checks.refused: A summary that passes the first two checks but not the others, or one you forward by hand from a listed mailbox, waits in your summary inbox for your OK. Anything else is refused, and its content is not stored by Meeting Guard AI.
